Tip_Convert: Convert an old (Python) flow from a project folder to the new format
Tip_AiFlow: Generate a flow from a description
Tip_Explain: Have the AI explain the current flow
Tip_Suggest: Have the AI suggest the next node after the selected one
Tip_Step: One node further, then pause again
Tip_Search: Find a node / jump to it (Ctrl+F)
Tip_Align: Snap all nodes to the grid
Tip_NodeSuggest: Toggle AI suggestion for the next node

Set_DriverPath: Playwright driver path (only if not found automatically)
Set_DriverHelp1: Driver/browsers won't download automatically? Guide for manual/offline installation:
Set_DriverHelp2: Behind a proxy: set the proxy in the “Network” tab (also applies to the download host).
Set_SessionReuse: Reuse session (cookies/login) — save it with the “Save session” node
Set_SessionFile: Session file (empty = session.json in the project folder)
Set_ProxyIntro: Proxy — applies to the browser and to AI requests.
Set_ProxyServer: Proxy server (empty = no proxy / system default)
Set_AiIntro: Generate a flow from a description (toolbar: 🤖 AI flow).
Set_DetectLocalAiTip: Checks for locally running LLM servers (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, Jan)
Set_BaseUrl: Base URL (optional, e.g. local Ollama instance)
Set_SendHints: Send hints / known fixes to the AI
Set_Hints: Known issues & fixes (one per line, keep them short — the AI receives them with every request)
Set_PluginsIntro: Custom nodes as a DLL in the plugins folder. Changes (enabled/disabled) take effect after a restart.
Set_NoPlugins: No plugins found. Put a DLL into one of the folders listed below and restart.
Set_PluginToggleTip: Enabled (checked) / disabled — takes effect after a restart
About_BuyMeCoffeeTip: Support development with a virtual coffee (buymeacoffee.com/kroste)
About_UpdateError: Update check failed (offline or proxy issue)

Chat_InputPlaceholder: Ask a question or describe a flow…  (Enter = send, Shift+Enter = new line)

Ns_NotConfigured: No AI connection configured. Please set an API key in the settings (“AI” tab) or choose Ollama as the provider.

Prop_PreviewHint: 👁 Preview — drag & drop into the flow to edit.

Node_function_Desc: Input/start point of the flow. Sets the initial payload values (replaces targets).
Node_function_Ex: payload = {"host":"https://example.com","user":"max"}  →  usable in the flow as {payload.host}
Node_goto_Desc: Navigates to a URL and waits for the page to load. With 'new_tab' = true a new tab is opened and switched to instead (replaces the open_tab node).
Node_goto_Ex: url = {payload.host}/login  →  opens the login page. new_tab = true → in a new tab.
Node_open_tab_Desc: Opens a new browser tab and switches to it. (Replaced by Navigate + new_tab.)
Node_open_tab_Ex: url = https://example.com  →  opens a new tab; subsequent actions run in it.
Node_close_tab_Ex: Closes the current tab and switches back to the remaining tab.
Node_get_links_Desc: Collects links and runs the 'per link' output for each link.
Node_get_links_Ex: selector = a.product  →  the 'per link' output runs for each link; current link in {link}.
Node_click_Desc: Clicks an element (with automatic scroll and retry). For download buttons set 'expect_download' = true — then the download is awaited and the file is saved with its real name in the download folder.
Node_click_Ex: selector = button#submit  →  clicks the submit button. Download: selector = a.download, expect_download = true.
Node_send_keys_Desc: Types text into an input field (fills the field). For single (special) keys like Enter/Tab/Escape use the 'Press key' node (press_key).
Node_send_keys_Ex: selector = input[name=q], value = {payload.searchword}  →  types the search term.
Node_wait_for_Desc: Waits until an element is visible/present.
Node_wait_for_Ex: selector = .result, state = visible  →  waits until results are visible.
Node_sleep_Desc: Pauses execution for a set time.
Node_menu_path_Ex: path = File, Export, PDF  →  hovers/clicks through the menu to PDF export.
Node_scroll_Desc: Scrolls the page up/down or to an element. Scrolling down repeatedly loads lazily added content (e.g. forum lists).
Node_scroll_Ex: to = bottom, times = 3  →  scrolls to the bottom three times (loads more results).
Node_press_key_Desc: Presses a (special) key or key combination — e.g. Enter to submit, Escape, Tab or Control+A. With a selector on an element, otherwise global.
Node_press_key_Ex: key = Enter, selector = input[name=q]  →  submits the search field.
Node_select_option_Desc: Selects an entry in a <select> dropdown — by value, visible text (label) or index.
Node_select_option_Ex: selector = select#country, by = label, value = Germany  →  selects “Germany”.
Node_hover_Desc: Moves the mouse over an element (e.g. to reveal a menu/tooltip).
Node_if_then_else_Desc: Conditional branch. Connect the 'then' and 'else' outputs to the following nodes. Valid conditions (condition): element_exists, element_visible, element_text, page_url, page_title, page_contains, page_matches, payload_equals, payload_contains. Comparison value in 'value'; DOM selector (or for payload_* the payload key) in 'selector'.
Node_if_then_else_Ex: condition = element_exists, selector = .error  →  match: 'then' output, otherwise: 'else' output.
Node_for_range_Desc: Repeats the 'loop' output for a number range.
Node_for_range_Ex: start = 1, end = 5  →  'loop' output runs 5x; current value in {i}.
Node_foreach_Desc: Iterates over a list/dictionary. Connect the 'item' output to the loop body.
Node_foreach_Ex: items = {payload.targets}  →  'item' output runs per element; fields as {payload.host} etc.
Node_call_Desc: Calls a named subnode as a subroutine.
Node_noop_Desc: Does nothing — useful as a placeholder or debug breakpoint.
Node_noop_Ex: No configuration — simply skips and continues.
Node_quit_Desc: Ends execution of this flow immediately.
Node_quit_Ex: Stops the flow at this point (e.g. after an error branch).
Node_assert_Desc: Checks a condition (like if_then_else) and aborts the path with an error message if it is NOT met. Valid conditions: element_exists, element_visible, element_text, page_url, page_title, page_contains, page_matches, payload_equals, payload_contains. Comparison value in 'value'; DOM selector or for payload_* the payload key in 'selector'.
Node_assert_Ex: condition = element_exists, selector = .success  →  flow error if .success is missing.
Node_get_value_Desc: Reads a value from the DOM (text, attribute) into the payload.
Node_get_value_Ex: selector = .price, ctx_key = price  →  reads the price text into {price}.
Node_set_payload_Desc: Sets a key in the payload object that flows through the connections.
Node_set_payload_Ex: key = status, value = ok  →  writes status into the payload ({payload.status}).
Node_debug_Desc: Prints payload/context in the execution log. Can pause the flow.
Node_debug_Ex: source = payload, pause = true  →  shows the payload in the log and waits for “Resume”.
Node_read_file_Desc: Reads a file into the payload.
Node_read_file_Ex: path = data.txt, ctx_key = content  →  reads the file into {content}.
Node_write_file_Desc: Writes a value to a file.
Node_write_file_Ex: path = out.txt, value = {payload.result}  →  writes the result to the file.
Node_download_url_Desc: Downloads a file from a URL.
Node_download_url_Ex: url = {payload.host}/file.pdf  →  downloads the file into the download folder.
Node_screenshot_Desc: Saves a screenshot of the page or an element as PNG. Empty path = timestamped file in the download/project folder. The path is stored in the payload under 'screenshot_path'.
Node_screenshot_Ex: selector = .card, path = receipt.png  →  PNG of the .card element.
Node_download_stream_Desc: Captures network traffic for a time window, detects media URLs (embedded videos/audio, HLS .m3u8, DASH .mpd) and writes them to the payload (ctx_key). Downloads direct files (mp4/mp3) via HTTP, segment streams via ffmpeg (must be installed/reachable). Note: playback should be running during execution; DRM streams cannot be downloaded.
Node_download_stream_Ex: wait_ms = 8000, download = true  →  detects the stream and saves it (stream_*.mp4).
Node_credential_store_Desc: Marks that the flow uses the encrypted credential vault and serves as an anchor for managing/unlocking it (double-click opens the vault). At flow start the vault is unlocked with the master password if secrets are used. Access values anywhere via {secret[name].user} / {secret[name].password} / {secret[name].api}. The values never enter the payload and are masked in logs.
Node_credential_store_Ex: Place it in the main flow; use fields such as {secret[F95].user} in “Type text”.
Node_use_session_Desc: Checks whether a saved session exists (and — with max_age_hours > 0 — is not too old). If so, its cookies are loaded into the running browser and the 'loaded' output is taken; otherwise 'no session'. This lets you navigate straight to the page when a session exists, otherwise run the login (and save it with save_session). localStorage is not restored — for cookie-based logins.
Node_use_session_Ex: 'loaded' output → Navigate to the page; 'no session' output → login + save_session.
Node_save_session_Desc: Saves the current session (cookies + localStorage) to a file. If “Reuse session” is enabled in the settings, it is loaded automatically on the next start → login and captcha are skipped. Empty path = settings path or session.json in the project folder.
Node_save_session_Ex: Insert after a successful login  →  the next run starts already logged in.
Node_page_function_Desc: Runs a JavaScript function in the context of the open page to manipulate it or read data. Without a selector: payload => { … }; with a selector: (element, payload) => { … }. The script receives the current payload as an argument. Return: if 'ctx_key' is set, the return value goes there; otherwise the fields of a returned object are merged into the payload. Use cases: show a hint/banner, highlight/remove elements, count/compute values, read hidden values. Note: the code is NOT substituted via {payload.x} — use the payload argument.
Node_page_function_Ex: code = payload => ({ count: document.querySelectorAll('a').length })  →  {count} in the payload.
Node_page_function_P_merge: Merge return object into the payload
Node_captcha_guard_Desc: Detects a CAPTCHA, (optionally) clicks the first “I'm not a robot” checkbox and then waits for the (possibly manual) solution. timeout_s = 0 means no time limit (waits until solved, or until the user presses “Stop”).
Node_captcha_guard_Ex: auto_click = true, timeout_s = 120  →  clicks the checkbox; the user solves a following image puzzle. timeout_s = 0 → waits indefinitely.
Node_ai_query_Desc: Sends the content of the current page (text or HTML) together with an instruction to the AI and stores the answer in the payload. Example: “Extract all product names and prices as JSON.” With a selector only one element is sent; with json=true a pure JSON answer is forced; max_chars limits the amount of text sent (cost/tokens). Provider/model are optionally selectable per node (empty = default from settings; the API key stored there is used). Requires a configured AI (Settings → AI).
Node_ai_query_Ex: prompt = Extract all threads as JSON {title,url}, ctx_key = data, json = true  →  {data}.
Node_note_Desc: Shows text on the canvas (no function). Style 'heading' = large heading, 'comment' = small comment. Replaces the former caption/label nodes (kept as aliases).
Node_note_Ex: style = heading, text = Configuration  →  large heading to structure the flow.
Node_caption_Desc: Shows a large heading on the canvas. No function. (Replaced by 'note'.)
Node_label_Desc: Shows a comment text on the canvas. No function. (Replaced by 'note'.)
